# SJU Luxe Travel

> Boutique boutique travel agency based in San Juan, Puerto Rico. Founded by Daniel Santiago Díaz, bilingual travel agent and private travel concierge. A boutique travel agency — not a large tour operator or travel wholesaler.

## About
SJU Luxe Travel is a boutique travel agency in San Juan, Puerto Rico. We craft bespoke, intentional travel experiences to destinations including the Maldives, Portugal, Mexico, and beyond. We are an independent agent of NCM Concierge, part of Travel Leaders, one of the most respected concierge travel networks in the Americas. As a bilingual travel agent (English & Spanish), we serve clients across the US mainland, the Caribbean, and Latin America. We specialize in private guided tours and bespoke itineraries — never group travel or mass-market packages.

## Services
- Bespoke travel itinerary planning (itinerarios a medida)
- Private guided tours — not group travel
- Honeymoon & anniversary travel planning
- Private travel concierge — Caribbean & beyond
- Intentional travel experiences
- Exclusive NCM Concierge perks & resort upgrades
- VIP transfers & private experiences
- Group & family travel
- Wellness retreats & cultural immersions
- cruises departing from San Juan Puerto Rico
- solo travel for women — Caribbean & beyond
- Corporate & incentive travel planner Puerto Rico
- Free travel consultation
- Exclusive destinations without mass tourism (destinos exclusivos sin turismo masivo)

## Destinations
- Maldives: Maldives travel packages — overwater villas, private dining, world-class diving
- Portugal: Portugal travel itinerary — Lisbon, Porto, Algarve, Douro Valley wine country
- Mexico: Mexico vacation packages — Riviera Maya, Tulum, Oaxaca, cenotes
- cruises from San Juan, Puerto Rico — Royal Caribbean, Celebrity Cruises, and more

## Why Choose a Boutique Travel Agency
- Boutique travel agency vs large tour operator — personalized, not mass-market
- Private guided tours vs group travel — every itinerary is bespoke
- Bilingual travel agent — English & Spanish
- Private travel concierge serving the Caribbean, US & Latin America
- Exclusive NCM Concierge perks unavailable when booking online
- Over a decade of sales experience across six continents
- Licensed in Florida (ST15578), California, Washington & Iowa
- Free travel consultation with personalized recommendations
